programme.title: Donizetti - L’elisir d’amore
programme.desc: Riccardo Frizza conducts the Orchestra Gli Originali and the Coro Donizetti Opera in a performance of Geatano Donizetti’s comic opera L’elisir d’amore (‘The Elixer of Love’, 1832). L’elisir d’amore is perhaps the most famous work in Donizetti’s extensive repertoire. It tells the story of the poor peasant Nemorino who is in love with the beautiful landowner Adina.

programme.title: Europakonzert 2000 from Berlin
programme.desc: Mikhail Pletnev (piano), Karita Mattila (soprano), Violeta Urmana (alto), Thomas Moser (tenor), Eike Wilm Schulte (bass), Swedish Radio Choir, Eric Ericson Chamber Choir, Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra, conductor: Claudio Abbado. Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827): Piano Concerto No. 2 in B flat major, Op. 19 - Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125. The European Concert has been a tradition of the Berliner Philharmoniker since 1991.

programme.title: Discovering Masterpieces - Brandenburg Concertos
programme.desc: This episode presents the Brandenburg Concertos by Johann Sebastian Bach (1685-1750). Musical excerpts played by the Freiburger Barockorchester conducted by Gottfried von der Goltz. Bach's six Brandenburg Concertos rank among the undisputed favorites of all baroque fans. They have become a firm fixture in music education and an integral part of our international musical heritage. So what's their secret?

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 5, 'Emperor'
programme.desc: Italian conductor Gianandrea Noseda leads the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 5 in E-flat major, Op. 73, famously known as the ‘Emperor’ Concerto. Italian pianist Beatrice Rana features as the soloist here. The New York Times describes her as ‘one of the most insightful and prodigiously gifted artists of the new generation’.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Semi-finals: Brahms, Britten a. o.
programme.desc: Soprano Vassia Alati (the Netherlands/Greece, 1992) and pianist Yuto Kiguchi (Japan, 1989) perform ‘C’est l’extase langoureuse’ from Claude Debussy’s Arriettes oubliées, L. 63, and ‘Fantoches’ from Debussy’s Fêtes galantes, L. 86; Bart Visman’s Het goud van Vermeer; ‘Lerchengesang’ from Johannes Brahms’s Vier Gesänge, Op. 70; Franz Schubert’s Gruppe aus dem Tartarus, Op. 24, No. 1, D.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Bach - Cello Suite No. 5 in C minor, BWV 1011
programme.desc: At St. Bartholomew Church in Dornheim, Germany, where composer Johann Sebastian Bach married his first wife Maria Barbara, renowned Dutch cellist Anner Bijlsma performs the composer's Cello Suite No. 5 in C minor, BWV 1011. It is likely Bach wrote his collection of six Suites for unaccompanied cello during the years 1717-1723.

programme.title: Mussorgsky - Night on Bald Mountain
programme.desc: Young Euro Classic is the world’s most important platform for international young orchestra musicians in the European classical music tradition, and for its development. For 17 days every summer, orchestras from all over the world perform at Berlin’s Konzerthaus, on Gendarmenmarkt. This performance features some highlights of the Young Euro Classic edition of 2016.

programme.title: Baroque choral music by Bach, Schütz et al.
programme.desc: Five-strong vocal ensemble amarcord is joined by an extra alto and two soprano voices for this unusual concert at Leipzig’s St. Thomas Church. As amarcordplus, the ensemble presents a program focused on the city of Leipzig, which includes sacred madrigals by Johann Hermann Schein, motets from Heinrich Schütz’s collection Geistliche Chor-Music, as well as two motets by the most famous Thomaskantor: Johann Sebastian Bach.

programme.title: Bach - Cantata 'Ich habe genug', BWV 82
programme.desc: The film Jaroussky sings Bach & Telemann is a portrait of a very special vocalist, and of two exceptional composers. When Philippe Jaroussky - whose angelic voice seems almost timeless, not belonging to any one epoque or decade - sings works by Telemann and Bach, it becomes abundantly clear that the sheer emotional force and the purifying power of their music have not diminished over the centuries.

programme.title: Memory of a Concert
programme.desc: In 2006, Gidon Kremer and Martha Argerich set out on tour performing solos and duets by Bartók und Schumann. The last of the concert series at the Berliner Philharmonie has been recorded for this film, featuring a rare solo performance by Martha Argerich. A concert film with personal and moving commentary by Gidon Kremer. Program: Schumann's Violin Sonata No. 1, Op. 10, Violin Sonata No. 2, Op. 121; Kinderszenen, Op.

programme.title: Schumann - Symphonic Etudes, Op. 13
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Symphonic Etudes, Op. 13. Composed between 1834-37, the work began as a theme and a set of sixteen variations.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 6
programme.desc: On November 14, 1987, a promising conductor made his Berlin Philharmonic debut with Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 6: Simon Rattle. In retrospect Rattle says, “I felt that I was finding my voice on that day.” Mahler’s multifaceted work is now again on the program when Sir Simon appears for the last time as chief conductor of the Berliner Philharmoniker in the Philharmonie in 2018. The wheel comes full circle. Mahler's Symphony No.

programme.title: Baroque works by Bach, Muffat and Rameau
programme.desc: Paul Goodwin conducts the Conjunto Barroco of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid in a Baroque music program featuring works by Georg Muffat, J. S. Bach, and Jean-Philippe Rameau. On the program are Muffat’s Sonata No. 5 in G major, 'Armonico tributo'; Bach’s Orchestral Suite No. 4 in D major, BWV 1069; and Rameau’s Suite from the opera ‘Les Boréades’.

programme.title: Music of Naples
programme.desc: Throughout the centuries, the Italian city of Naples has proved to have a remarkably favorable climate for artistic innovation. The presence of the royal or vice royal courts, the practice of music in churches, fraternities, and charitable institutions, financial support from well-to-do citizens, and the popularity of song and dance in public life made for an extraordinarily diverse musical landscape.

programme.title: Schumann - Piano Quintet in E-flat major, Op. 44
programme.desc: At the behest of Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich, several classical music stars took part in this concert in aid of the Erasmus Fund for medical research in intensive care, recorded at the Royal Conservatory of Brussels, Belgium, on October 21, 2023. The concert pays tribute to the renowned cellist Aleksandr Khramouchin (1979) who suddenly passed away on May 13, 2023.

programme.title: Copland - Appalachian Spring
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Aaron Copland’s Appalachian Spring Suite. Originally commissioned as a ballet for the legendary dancer Martha Graham, Aaron Copland's Appalachian Spring (1944) has since become an American classic. While first scored for a thirteen-piece ensemble, Copland later arranged the work for a full orchestra.

programme.title: Niccolò Jommelli - Requiem
programme.desc: In 1754, Jommelli took up the position of “Ober-Kapellmeister” at the ducal court of Stuttgart. There he wrote not only operas, serenatas and pastorales but also religious music for special occasions. One example is his Requiem, a musical farewell to the mother of Jommelli’s patron. Counterpoint German style, French ornamentation, and Italian drama come together in this unique blend, which clearly bears Naples’ signature.

programme.title: Brahms - Symphony No. 4, Op. 98
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts The Cleveland Orchestra in this performance of Brahms' Symphony No. 4. This is the final of the composer's short selection of symphonic works. Described by music critic Malcolm Macdonald as one of the “supreme creative acts of the Romantic era,” Brahms' Fourth Symphony is endowed with a strong undercurrent of subdued melancholy. It seems to pine for an irretrievable past.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 10
programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 10 is an unfinished work left by the composer at his death, representing his ultimate emotional journey from torment and heartbreak to an unreserved acceptance of life and human love.

programme.title: Berlioz - The Damnation of Faust
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle and the London Symphony Orchestra mark 150 years since the death of Hector Berlioz with his tempestuous oratorio, La damnation de Faust. La damnation de Faust is a work born of the composer’s obsession with Goethe’s legendary tale. Once a righteous scholar, Faust allows himself to be corrupted by the devil, and drags the innocent around him into desperation and death.

programme.title: CMIM Piano 2024 - Semi-final I: Derek Wang
programme.desc: Pianist Derek Wang (USA, 1998) joins the CMIM ensemble, consisting of three principal strings players of the Montreal Symphony Orchestra, in a performance of the first movement, Allegro, of Johannes Brahms’s Piano Quartet No 1. in G minor, Op. 25. This performance took place during the chamber music round of the two-part semi-final of the Piano Edition of the Concours musical international de Montréal 2024 (CMIM).

programme.title: Documentary: Gianandrea Noseda
programme.desc: Although the great Italian composer Giuseppe Verdi applied unsuccessfully to study at the Milan Conservatory, this renowned college of music was eventually named after him. Today, the ‘Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi’ counts numerous successful musicians among its alumni: from Giacomo Puccini, Alfredo Catalani, Claudio Abbado, Riccardo Chailly, Luigi Einaudi and Daniele Gatti, to Gianandrea Noseda.

programme.title: Holst - The Planets
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam and the Nationaal Vrouwen Jeugdkoor in a performance of Gustav Holst’s The Planets, Op. 32, recorded at De Doelen, Rotterdam, in 2019. Van Alphen founded Sinfonia Rotterdam in 2000. Under his passionate leadership, this orchestra has developed into one of the Netherland’s best-known orchestras.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 2, Op. 17
programme.desc: American conductor Michael Tilson Thomas leads the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in an energetic performance of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's folk-infused Symphony No. 2 in C minor, Op. 17. Written in 1872, the work is nicknamed 'Little Russian' as the composer used several folk tunes from Ukraine, then known as ‘Little Russia’. This performance was recorded at LSO St Luke's, London, on May 31, 2021.

programme.title: Mozart - Requiem in D minor, K. 626
programme.desc: Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra and Choir of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino and four vocal soloists in a magnificent performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Requiem in D minor, K. 626. The soloists are soprano Christiane Karg, mezzosoprano Sara Mingardo, tenor Matthew Swensen, and bass Gianluca Buratto. The Austrian Count Walsegg commissioned Mozart to compose a Requiem in July 1791 to commemorate his late wife, Anna.

programme.title: Ice Dance: Nutcracker 2011
programme.desc: This stunning performance of theatrical ice dancing brings viewers into the enchanting world of Tchaikovsky's magnificent holiday classic, The Nutcracker On Ice, performed by the internationally renowned Imperial Ice Stars, and including former champion figure skaters, Vadim Yarkov and Olga Sharutenko. This very special performance and soundtrack was performed by the Manchester Symphony Orchestra, conducted by Tim A.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Iolanta
programme.desc: ‘Iolanta’ and ‘Perséphone’ – A double bill consisting of two stage works that “represent an ideal of beauty, poetry and hope” forms this new production by Peter Sellars in Madrid from the Teatro Real from 2012. In both works, the progression from darkness to light acts as an initiation rite that completely transforms the existential attitude of the leading characters.

programme.title: Salif Keita & Les Ambassadeurs
programme.desc: Salif Keita’s music is a rich combination of traditional Malian music with European and American influences. We can hear this in the instrumentation of Keita’s music, which varies from traditional West-African instruments to Western European ones. The Malian singer was cast out by his family because of his albinism. In 1967 he moved to Bamako, where he started his musical career and joined Les Ambassadeurs (Internationaux).

programme.title: Kurt Rosenwinkel meets Peter Beets Trio
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who has a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: Dave Brubeck and Paul Desmond live in Belgium
programme.desc: Dave Brubeck: Live in '64 boasts a beautifully filmed concert from one of the most beloved quartets in jazz history.

programme.title: Bayerischer Hof Night Club: Maria João Quartet
programme.desc: In this recording, the Portuguese singer Maria João makes her appearance at the Bayerischer Hof Night Club during the 1999 Münchner Klaviersommer. She is accompanied by Marcio Doctor (percussion), Miroslav Tadic (guitar), and her long-standing partner, the brilliant pianist Mário Laginha. Maria is known for her vocal flexibility and improvisational skills.

programme.title: Sven Hammond Soul: Tivoli de Helling
programme.desc: Although its music might sound like the soundtrack of any 1970s American car chase movie, the band Sven Hammond Soul is from the Netherlands. This steaming soul machine is headed by Sven Figee, who prefers to attack rather than play his Hammond organ. In April 2012, the band was augmented with vocalist Jenny Lane. Today’s recordings were made at a steaming live performance at Utrecht’s Tivoli in 2012.

programme.title: jazzahead! 2023 interview
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Dilemma
programme.desc: Formed in 1952 from the rhythm section of Dizzy Gillespie's big band, the Modern Jazz Quartet took its inspiration from classical chamber music as well as jazz's blues roots. The group enjoyed a decades-long career with multiple critically acclaimed albums, cementing their place in the history of the genre.

programme.title: Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah, West Of The West
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic “stretch music”; an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Kapok
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Chamber music: Sissoko & Segal
programme.desc: Hailing from a long tradition of Malian kora players, Ballake Sissoko has worked with renowned musicians such as Toumani Diabaté and Taj Mahal. He met the French born Vincent Ségal by chance, and the two began jamming together, uncertain of what kind of music might result.

programme.title: Georgie Fame & the Blue Flames
programme.desc: Georgie Fame, known for 'Yeh, Yeh' and 'The Ballad of Bonnie and Clyde' makes a triumphant comeback with The Blue Flames. Georgie Fame and the Blue Flames was a popular band in the UK in the '60s, celebrated for its R&B, soul, jazz, ska, and pop sounds. The training was largely inspired by ska, a popular musical style in Jamaican cafes in London at the time.

programme.title: Portrait of Roy Ayers
programme.desc: ‘The legend of the groove’ is a series of documentaries devoted to the musicians who were most influential on contemporary hip hop, soul, rhythm 'n' blues, and on the course of history. Between the late 1950s and now, these musicians radically changed music. Although sometimes hardly in the public eye, they have all been major sources of inspiration for today's major artists: Prince, Erykah Badu, Janis Joplin and Jimi Hendrix.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Fanfaraï
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Jon Hendricks and Co: Estival 1986
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence.

programme.title: Miriam Makeba Live at Estival Lugano 1985
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Miriam Makeba, also named Mama Africa, was a South African singer, actress, United Nations goodwill ambassador, and civil-rights activist.

programme.title: A$AP Rocky & A$AP Ferg - At The Hordern Pavilion
programme.desc: Big hits, booty dancing, stage dives, fan freestyles and of course, controversy, A$AP Rocky's debut Down Under tour had it all! At his sold-out Sydney show, hip hop's hottest star and 5000 rowdy fans got wild for the night at the Hordern Pavilion and we captured it all exclusively.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Breaking Point
programme.desc: In 1988, Dee Dee Bridgewater was one of the first great jazz singers to perform at the Jazz Festival in Ramatuelle. In 2016, the story seems to repeat itself as her daughter China Moses took the stage at Ramatuelle. Over the years, China Moses has become a mature performer with a unique style: rocky voice, sharp sense of swing, and intense/energetic stage presence.

programme.title: Episode 3: Miles Davis - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American trumpeter Miles Davis (1926-1991) was a pioneering jazz musician from the late 1940s to the late 1980s. His influence on 20th century music is hard to overstate, as he trailblazed bebop, cool jazz, hardbop, modal jazz, and electronic music. On October 11, 1964, Miles Davis performed at Teatro Dell’Arte in Milan.

programme.title: Clark Terry Big Band - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Tigran Hamasyan & Mathias Eick - November Music
programme.desc: November Music, a Dutch music festival in ’s-Hertogenbosch, showcases today's prominent composers. It programs top-notch ensembles, jazz and world music pioneers, interdisciplinary concerts, and sound art. In 2019, Tigran Hamasyan and Mathias Eick played a duo performance here. Armenian pianist Hamasyan has claimed a category of his own in contemporary jazz. Norwegian trumpeter Mathias Eick is an undisputed master of his instrument.

programme.title: MotorMusic Jazz Session: From Rossini to Piazzolla
programme.desc: The MotorMusic Studios in Mechelen, Belgium, attract many great musicians to the city. A wide variety of visiting international jazz musicians share their art of making jazz music with us in the DJAZZ series ‘Belgium Sessions’. In these sessions, some of Europe’s finest musicians perform their own, original music.

programme.title: Maceo Parker: Jazz à Juan
programme.desc: As a 25-year-old saxophonist, Maceo Parker played in the band of James Brown, but he is also known for his collaborations with George Clinton's Parliament-Funkadelic and Bootsy Collins' Rubber Band. Maceo has proven his star quality by creating a special chemistry between all the different styles of American black music. As a pioneer in the ‘groove’, he blends funky jazz with roots and blues with gospel. The result?

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: The Morgenland Festival: The Art of Duo
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival of Osnabrueck has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects.

programme.title: Hi-Fi-Fo-Fum
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On November 2, 1958, American jazz titan Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed two concerts at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam.

programme.title: Episode 3: Miles Davis - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American trumpeter Miles Davis (1926-1991) was a pioneering jazz musician from the late 1940s to the late 1980s. His influence on 20th century music is hard to overstate, as he trailblazed bebop, cool jazz, hardbop, modal jazz, and electronic music. On October 11, 1964, Miles Davis performed at Teatro Dell’Arte in Milan.

programme.title: Os Capoeira - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the bands taking part in this series is Os Capoeira.

programme.title: Comblain-la-Tour Jazz Festival: Jimmy McGriff Trio
programme.desc: As one of the best Hammond B3 organ players, Jimmy McGriff (1936-2008) is often lost among great soul-jazz organists from his hometown of Philadelphia. Of the major soul-jazz pioneers, he was the bluesiest and often insisted that he was more of a blues musician than a jazz artist. Regardless, he remained eclectic enough to blur the lines of genres.

programme.title: Moanin'
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

programme.title: Invisible World - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: Bakolo Music International - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: The Who - Live At The Isle Of Wight Festival 2004
programme.desc: In 2004 The Who returned to the Isle Of Wight Festival for the first time since their legendary performance in 1970. After a long absence, the festival had been reborn in 2002 and continues to this day. Their UK concerts in 2004 were the first in their home country since the death of founder member John Entwistle.

programme.title: Leon Bridges - Live in London 2015
programme.desc: The Apple Music Festival (formerly known as the iTunes Festival) was a music concert series held by Apple, Inc. inaugurated in 2007.

programme.title: Various Artists - iConcerts Hits
programme.desc: A selection of our best concert previews and exclusive interviews.

programme.title: Justin Timberlake - FutureSex/LoveShow - Live from New York
programme.desc: The FutureSex/LoveSounds album, which spawned the tour FutureSex/LoveShow, is one of the most awarded 2007 albums and has sold more than eight million copies worldwide. 'Sexyback', 'What Comes Around ... Goes Around', 'My Love', 'Summer Love' and 'Lovestoned' are some of the highlights and were among the most played of the year around the world.

programme.title: Grace Mitchell - Apple Music Festival
programme.desc: The Apple Music Festival (formerly known as the iTunes Festival) was a music concert series held by Apple, Inc. inaugurated in 2007.

programme.title: Various Artists - iConcerts Hits
programme.desc: A selection of our best concert previews and exclusive interviews.

programme.title: AC/DC - Live in Madrid
programme.desc: No Bull is a 16mm concert shot at the Plaza de Toros de Las Ventas, Madrid, on July 10, 1996, during the Ballbreaker tour of Australian hard rock band AC / DC.

programme.title: Pet Shop Boys - Live at Roskilde 2009
programme.desc: Filmed in Roskilde, Denmark, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Classic Pet Shop Boys featuring unforgettable version of their hits: 'Always On My Mind', 'West End Girls', 'Being Boring' and many more...

programme.title: Various Artists - iConcerts Hits
programme.desc: A selection of our best concert previews and exclusive interviews.

programme.title: Eric Clapton & Steve Winwood - Live from MSG
programme.desc: History rocked and rock made history during a sold-out three-gig stand at Madison Square Garden in late February 2008 when icons Eric Clapton and Steve Winwood performed a concert together for the first time since their all-too-brief days in the legendary Blind Faith in 1969. Whether they will ever team again is unknown.

programme.title: The Strokes - Live at Landmark Music Festival
programme.desc: And as with other hugely successful rock bands, it was the lead singer who was in charge of pumping up the crowd, with Julian Casablancas yelling things like “D.C., let’s rock!” and “What’s up, D.C.?!” The crowd went wild, but to Casablancas, it was clearly a joke. He was playing a role and said as much outright at the beginning of the show, but that didn’t stop the crowd, hungry for more entertainment, from taking him seriously.

programme.title: Robbie Williams - Live at the Apple Music Festival
programme.desc: A brand new show that brings a veteran artist at his best! The talented artist, who became famous in the group 'Take That', lacks presentations, but he himself begins his show by saying: 'Let me resubmit ...'. Robbie Williams has the ability to reinvent himself, exhibiting so much energy that he seems to be a rookie artist.

programme.title: Santana - Plays The Blues: Live at Montreux 2004
programme.desc: July 12, 2004 was a very special night at the Montreux Festival for any blues fan. With Carlos Santana as musical director (and special guest guitarist), three musical legends took to the stage. Each one delivered a full concert set packed with some of the finest blues guitar playing you'll ever hear.

programme.desc: A selection of our best concert previews and exclusive interviews.

programme.title: Rush - The Rise Of Kings
programme.desc: Through a stunning combination of rare footage and insider insight this film traces the complete history of Rush.

programme.title: Céline Dion - That's Just The Woman In Me
programme.desc: That's Just the Woman in Me is an American television special by Canadian singer Celine Dion which was aired on CBS on February 15, 2008 and was recorded at the Wiltern Theater in Los Angeles, California.

programme.title: Various Artists - iConcerts Hits
programme.desc: A selection of our best concert previews and exclusive interviews.

programme.title: George Thorogood & the Destroyers - Live at Montreux 2013
programme.desc: George Thorogood is an American icon. In a career that stretches back to the mid-seventies, he and his band The Destroyers have released 16 studio albums with worldwide sales in excess of 15 million. 2013 saw George & The Destroyers make their long overdue debut at the legendary Montreux Jazz Festival.

programme.title: AC/DC - Circus Krone
programme.desc: Filmed at the world famous Circus Krone in Munich, this AC/DC concert from June 17, 2003 features standout performances of 'Rock N Roll Damnation' and 'What's Next To The Moon' and more.

programme.title: Limp Bizkit - Live at Reading Festival
programme.desc: The Reading Festival are a pair of annual rock music festivals that take place in Reading and Leeds in England. The events take place simultaneously on the Friday, Saturday and Sunday of the August bank holiday weekend, sharing the same bill.

programme.title: Carrie Underwood - Live in London 2015
programme.desc: Watch Carrie Underwood performing live at the Apple Music Festival. What a unique concert experience, not only for the fans at the Roundhouse, but also for fans across the globe!.

programme.title: Rod Stewart - Live at Hyde Park
programme.desc: A concert by the legendary Rod Stewart, that closed Radio 2's Annual Festival In A Day, held in September 2015 in London's Hyde Park.

programme.title: Various Artists - iConcerts Hits
programme.desc: A selection of our best concert previews and exclusive interviews.

programme.title: Deep Purple - Live in Verona
programme.desc: Filmed in the spectacular surroundings of the Arena di Verona, a Roman amphitheater originally built in 30 AD, this concert from the summer of 2011 sees Deep Purple joined on stage by a full symphony orchestra for performances of all their classic tracks. Deep Purple remains one of the finest hard rock bands on the planet and are undoubtedly at their best when performing live.

programme.title: R.E.M. - Live in Milan 2008
programme.desc: Filmed at Arena Civica, Milan, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Classic R.E.M. featuring unforgettable version of their hits: 'Losing My Religion', 'Drive', 'Man On the Moon' and many more.

programme.desc: Quando Ben incorpora um caçador de prémios encarregado de escoltar o criminoso mais fugidio do mundo, uma perseguição mortífera obriga-os a esconder-se, mas Ben rapidamente se apercebe que esta viagem no tempo é mais do que aparentava ser. Addison depara-se com uma decisão difícil.

programme.desc: A investigação de Melinda de um espirito no hospital leva a que uma força sobrenatural a aterrorize e ao seu filho..

programme.title: Lucifer T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Quando um velho conhecido tem um desfecho violento, o charmoso Lucifer jura vigança sobre os responsáveis e forma uma aliança inesperada.

programme.title: A Máscara 2 - A Nova Geração
programme.desc: Tim Avery, um aspirante a cartoonista, vê-se numa situação difícil quando o seu cão tropeça na máscara de Loki. Assim, depois de conceber um filho “nascido da máscara”, descobre o quão louco pode ser criar filhos.

programme.title: Viagem Ao Centro Da Terra
programme.desc: Com o intuito de descobrir o que aconteceu ao irmão desaparecido, um cientista, o seu sobrinho e o seu guia de montanha descobrem uma fantástica e perigoso mundo perdido no centro da Terra. .

programme.title: Lucifer T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Apesar de sentir o desejo de regressar ao inferno, Lucifer arranja tempo para investigar como uns paparazzi com excesso de entusiasmo contribuíram para a morte de um jovem.

programme.title: Lucifer T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Um quarterback profissional prestes a atingir estatuto de estrela acorda diante de uma descoberta macabra e pede a Lucifer para ajudá-lo a provar a sua inocência.

programme.title: Lucifer T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Lucifer tenta seduzir Chloe, mas ela não é como a maioria das mulheres. Entretanto, Amenadiel partilha as suas preocupações com Maze sobre Lucifer.

programme.title: Green Lantern - Lanterna Verde
programme.desc: O imprudente piloto de testes Hal Jordan recebe um anel alienígena que lhe confere poderes sobrenaturais que o induzem a uma força policial intergaláctica, a Green Lantern Corps.

programme.title: O Terremoto
programme.desc: Em 1904, um terramoto com magnitude de 5,4 na escala de Richter fez tremer Oslo, com epicentro no “Oslo Graben”, que corre debaixo da capital norueguesa. Agora há sinais que indicam que podemos esperar um terramoto grande em Oslo no futuro.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

programme.title: Amigos para sempre T1 - Ep. 25
programme.desc: Eren, Seda, Merve e Yunus são quatro amigos que se conheceram há um ano, quando estudavam na universidade. No primeiro ano de aula, Seda conhece seu amigo de infância Gizem. Seda e Gizem, desde o primeiro momento se unem como antigamente estavam ligados um ao outro. Porém, os equilíbrios do grupo começam a mudar em breve.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T1 - Ep. 76
programme.desc: Ressurreição conta a história da tribo Kayi, uma das tribos turcas que se afastaram das estepes da Ásia Central e que chegou aos territórios da Anatólia. Ertugrul, que tem os seus objetivos, e não tem medo de morrer pela sua religião, pela sua terra natal e pela sua família, luta contra o poder imperial do seu tempo com uma estrutura inteligente e visionária.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 38
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

Diante dessa ameaça iminente, o Povo decide organizar-se para expulsar a empresa das suas terras.

programme.title: Chicago Fire T14 - Ep. 20
programme.desc: A corajosa equipa do Quartel de Bombeiros 51 arrisca a vida para proteger e salvar os habitantes da sua cidade.

programme.desc: A corajosa equipa do Quartel de Bombeiros 51 arrisca a vida para proteger e salvar os habitantes da sua cidade.

programme.title: A Rapariga do Baloiço
programme.desc: Um negociante de arte londrino viaja para Copenhaga e contrata uma secretária trilingue. Apesar de saber pouco sobre ela, casam-se. O passado dela ressurge misteriosamente após o casamento, afetando a relação entre os dois enquanto ele lida com a situação.

programme.title: O Ritual
programme.desc: Num convento isolado, dois sacerdotes divididos pela dúvida unem-se contra a possessão de Emma Schmidt. Traumas pessoais e horrores ancestrais culminam num exorcismo épico e visceral.

programme.title: Together: Juntos
programme.desc: Tim e Millie mudam-se para o campo, deixando tudo para trás. Com a relação em crise, um encontro com uma força sobrenatural ameaça destruir as suas vidas, o amor que os une e até a sua própria carne.

programme.title: Não Deixemos Que Tudo Se Perca Esta Noite
programme.desc: Rhodesia, 1980. A vida de Bobo, uma menina de 8 anos, é marcada pela guerra e tensões raciais. Entre a luta da família branca pela terra e o despertar para a injustiça, Bobo tenta compreender o seu mundo em mudança.

programme.title: O Ano da Morte de Ricardo Reis
programme.desc: Ricardo Reis chega a Lisboa a 29 de Dezembro de 1935, um tempo particularmente sombrio na Europa.. Depois de visitar a sepultura de Fernando Pessoa, o fantasma do poeta aparece-lhe e ambos perdem-se em reflexões sobre a vida, o país e o mundo..

programme.title: Monsieur Aznavour
programme.desc: Filho de refugiados, pequeno, pobre, nada parecia indicar que pudesse conquistar o sucesso. Mas com trabalho e uma perseverança incomum, Charles Aznavour tornou-se um monumento da canção, um símbolo da cultura francesa.

programme.title: Um Casamento na Costa Rica
programme.desc: Uma desastrada dama de honor recebe a ajuda do seu belo arqui-inimigo quando as coisas correm mal no casamento da sua melhor amiga na Costa Rica.

programme.title: O Lugar do Trabalho
programme.desc: Na siderúrgica ILVA de Taranto, um operário infiltrado por gestores trai os colegas para sobreviver num inferno de corrupção e poluição. Baseado num escândalo real que revela as condições desumanas de alguns trabalhadores.

programme.title: Na Linha da Frente
programme.desc: Floria, jovem enfermeira num hospital suíço sobrelotado, enfrenta um turno noturno exaustivo, com poucos recursos e demasiados doentes, até que um erro inesperado a coloca perante uma corrida angustiante contra o tempo.?.

programme.title: Os Rapazes de Nickel
programme.desc: Nos anos 60, dois rapazes enfrentam a brutalidade de um reformatório segregacionista na Flórida. Entre injustiça e amizade, lutam para sobreviver a um sistema cruel e racista com coragem e esperança.

programme.title: Ainda Estou Aqui
programme.desc: Rio de Janeiro, anos 70. O Brasil enfrenta a repressão cada vez maior de uma ditadura militar. Eunice Paiva, mãe de cinco filhos, é obrigada reinventar a sua vida após a sua família sofrer um ato violento e arbitrário do governo militar.

programme.title: Terras Sem Lei
programme.desc: Duas missionárias testemunham um assassinato cometido por pistoleiros contratados e fogem. Elas tropeçam na cabana de dois assassinos contratados aposentados que concordam em ajudar as mulheres a encontrar segurança, mas apenas suas armas podem garantir essa promessa.

programme.title: The Ministry Of Ungentlemanly Warfare
programme.desc: Os militares britânicos recrutam um pequeno grupo de soldados altamente qualificados para atacar as forças alemãs atrás das linhas inimigas durante a Segunda Guerra Mundial.

programme.title: Não Fales do Mal
programme.desc: Uma família americana é convidada para passar um fim de semana no idílico cenário rural de uma família britânica, que conheceu nas férias e cuja amizade se consolidou. Mas ninguém suspeitava que um tempo de lazer se transformaria num pesadelo.

programme.title: Abigail
programme.desc: Após um grupo de criminosos raptar a filha de 12 anos de um poderoso manda-chuva do submundo, uma bailarina, a sua missão é vigiar a criança numa mansão isolada. Rapidamente os raptores descobrem que estão trancados com uma rapariga nada comum.

Ao mesmo tempo, é a história de uma esquecida vila portuguesa do interior que vai encontrar um novo fôlego com a reabertura de umas antigas minas de ouro. Tal como a protagonista, que irá passar das maiores provações às maiores riquezas.

Dada como morta, Verónica assume a identidade da irmã e deseja vingar-se da família do empresário.

programme.title: Entrelinhas - Ep. 21
programme.desc: Um olhar diferente sobre os mais diversos assuntos da atualidade para lhe explicar tudo que está escrito nas entrelinhas. programme.title: Eu Sou O Milagre - Ep. 104
programme.desc: A afirmação é para muitos uma expressão que exige verdade e coragem, contudo no programa Eu sou o Milagre poderá conhecer depoimentos de pessoas que passaram a ser o verdadeiro milagre.Na primeira pessoa entenderá que todos temos uma história que merece ser conhecida, sobretudo quando se alcança a superação através do poder da Fé. Ganhe coragem e motivação neste programa que mostra que tudo é possível àquele que crê.

programme.title: Decisão - Ep. 103
programme.desc: Tomar uma decisão nem sempre é uma tarefa fácil, sobretudo para quem se encontra imbuído de problemas existe o medo de se avançar um passo e se recuar dois. Mas neste programa é transmitida a força e coragem para se tomar a decisão, a melhor e mais certa em prol de um rumo digno de conquistas, superações e acontecimentos positivos. Tome a decisão de assistir a este programa que será um acrescento diário.

programme.title: Casos Reais - Ep. 145
programme.desc: A história de vida, de cada pessoa, do início ao fim. Nos Casos Reais vai conhecer histórias sem filtros, a mais pura verdade de cada vida, contada na primeira pessoa.O fim de uma doença, a recuperação do casamento, o desfecho feliz de perda, aqui irá conhecer os testemunhos de pessoas que contam como alcançaram a superação, através da fé!.

programme.title: Ponto De Luz Lisboa - Ep. 21
programme.desc: O programa mostra que não há limites para a fé. Todos os dias, casos verídicos de pessoas que superaram os seus problemas e hoje têm uma vida transformada.

programme.title: Não Desista - Ep. 145
programme.desc: Programa com casos reais de superação, abordando temas que ajudam a resolver problemas diários em diversas áreas da sua vida.

programme.title: Em Busca Do Amor - Ep. 146
programme.desc: O programa Em Busca do Amor ensina-lhe os segredos para um amor pleno e duradouro. Entender como resolver as divergências e alcançar a plenitude na relação, são diretrizes essenciais para quem já tem um casamento. Já para os solteiros são transmitidos conselhos de como escolher e desenvolver um bom relacionamento e assim como dicas de como ser um/a excelentes companheiros/as.

programme.title: Problemas Soluções - Ep. 146
programme.desc: Dificuldades e obstáculos todos teremos de enfrentar ao longo da vida, mas por vezes, estes são de tal forma graves que parecem não ter solução. Seja uma doença, um problema na família, no casamento, na vida financeira ou espiritual.Por vezes, as forças desaparecem e não parece haver luz ao fundo do túnel. Mas, acredite que para qualquer tipo de problema existe uma solução.

programme.title: Ponto De Luz Porto - Ep. 21
programme.desc: Inveja, mau olhado, dores no corpo, depressão, azares que surgem sem razão aparente, têm muitas das vezes origem no oculto. Situações que a sociedade não sabe como resolver e permanece até que o pior aconteça. Contudo este é o programa que lhe mostra que não há limites para a fé e que tudo o que se encontra obscuro na vida, pode ser transformado.

programme.title: Algarve - Ep. 146
programme.desc: A partir do sul do país, o Programa do Algarve é produzido com o intuito de revelar histórias que desafiam a medicina, que ultrapassam e superam diagnósticos, que mostram como tudo é possível na vida daquele que crê.

programme.title: França - Ep. 146
programme.desc: Diretamente de França, este é um programa pensado para todas as pessoas que têm urgência em mudar e neste programa vão ter a oportunidade de conhecer casos reais de superação, abordando temas que ajudam a resolver problemas diários em diversas áreas da vida.

programme.title: Ponto De Luz Lisboa - Ep. 21
programme.desc: O programa mostra que não há limites para a fé. Todos os dias, casos verídicos de pessoas que superaram os seus problemas e hoje têm uma vida transformada.

programme.title: Vencendo Os Vícios - Ep. 146
programme.desc: Drogas, tabaco, jogo, pornografia são dos vícios que mais afetam a sociedade. Adições que levam inúmeras pessoas à falência, a perder empregos e ainda cortar os laços familiares e amizades. Assumir e superar nem sempre é uma atitude fácil de tomar por quem sofre com um vício, mas que neste programa poderá compreender o que pode ser feito para vencer de uma vez por todas, o vício, seja ele qual for.

programme.title: Coimbra - Ep. 146
programme.desc: Programa de Coimbra, remete-nos a uma cidade tão lusitana, que oferece a quem assiste uma esperança num amanhã melhor, com a transmissão de casos impressionantes de quem um dia tomou a atitude de confiar no poder da fé.

programme.title: Milagres Nas Ilhas - Ep. 146
programme.desc: Diretamente da pérola do Atlântico para si, produzimos um programa totalmente dedicado à transmissão de casos impressionantes de transformação. Mostramos as provas reais de que mesmo perante o maior dos problemas, existe luz ao fundo do túnel, para todos os que colocam a fé em prática e mudam a rota da vida. Milagre nas Ilhas mostra-lhe que mesmo longe, o milagre acontece.

programme.title: Café Com Fé - Ep. 125
programme.desc: O Bispo Domingos Siqueira apresenta o programa 'Café com Fé' que comprova que qualquer problema na vida é possível de ser superado! Acompanhe e veja testemunhos poderosos, de pessoas que tiveram suas vidas transformadas. De segunda a sábado, das 08h às 09h da manhã.

programme.title: Hora Dos Milagres - Ep. 104
programme.desc: Esta é uma hora dedicada totalmente a lhe dar a conhecer impressionantes milagres.Milagres acontecem? Sim! Este programa é a prova de que sim! Esta é a Hora dos Milagres, onde o impossível, torna-se possível.

programme.title: Morning Show - Ep. 104

Temos todos os ingredientes necessários para começar bem o dia!.

programme.title: Problemas Soluções - Ep. 146
programme.desc: Dificuldades e obstáculos todos teremos de enfrentar ao longo da vida, mas por vezes, estes são de tal forma graves que parecem não ter solução. Seja uma doença, um problema na família, no casamento, na vida financeira ou espiritual.Por vezes, as forças desaparecem e não parece haver luz ao fundo do túnel. Mas, acredite que para qualquer tipo de problema existe uma solução.

Sintomas como tristeza constante, desânimo, falta de vontade para viver são sentimentos de quem sofre com depressão. Sendo este um problema sério com urgente resolução, o programa Saindo da Depressão tem sido a alavanca de mudança para inúmeras pessoas que superaram esta patologia, que infelizmente ainda mata.

programme.title: Milagres De Jesus - Ep. 104

Para todos os problemas, a fé tem um desfecho essencial, por isso veja neste programa, como os Milagres Acontecem. Os milagres existem e este programa é a prova disso mesmo.

programme.title: Nosso Tempo - Ep. 125

Em Reflexões com Bispo Edir Macedo poderá reter uma mensagem única em cada episódio, que lhe irá deixar em reflexão e consequentemente mudança sobre as lacunas que enfrenta todos os dias.

programme.title: Oração Da Família Ao Pé Da Cruz - Ep. 146

Neste momento, acompanhe também relatos de pessoas que foram transformadas de dentro para fora e que assim alcançaram a verdadeira felicidade, através das orações ao pé da Cruz.

programme.title: Quero É Viver - Ep. 284
programme.desc: “Quero é Viver” é uma novela sobre o empoderamento feminino e a esperança. Com ternura e humor, narra a história de Ana e das suas quatro filhas que, depois da mãe de 70 anos terminar um casamento de 50, acabarão também por dar uma volta de 180 graus às suas próprias vidas.

programme.title: Inspetor Max
programme.desc: A série centra-se no dia a dia do inspetor da polícia judiciária, Jorge Mendes e do seu colega, cão polícia, Max.Além de ser uma peça fundamental para a resolução de crimes, Max é um elemento fundamental da família de Jorge.Reveja todas as temporadas no TVI Player.

programme.title: Morangos Com Açúcar - Ep. 57

programme.title: V+ Futebol: Clássico
programme.desc: Seja dia de jogo ou não, esta vai ser, a partir de agora, a casa do futebol. Com uma programação pensada e dedicada, João Ricardo Pateiro leva até si relatos emocionantes dos jogos dos três maiores clubes portugueses –Benfica, Porto e Sporting. Vibre com cada lance, sinta a paixão dos adeptos em tempo real e viva o melhor de dois mundos: emoção e rigor, sempre com a máxima espetacularidade.

programme.title: V+ Fama
programme.desc: Se gosta de saber tudo o que acontece no mundo glamouroso das celebridades nacionais e internacionais, este programa é perfeito para si.O que tem acontecido nas vidas dos famosos? Quem esteve nas festas? Quem arranjou novo namoro ou terminou com o antigo? Tudo se vai descobrir neste programa. Além das reações no digital, vai haver comentários em estúdio e até ligação em direto com os protagonistas.
